# obs.option_open r1

obs.option_open r1: one planned option contract pulled at the open of a session day and slot; one row per planned item. Open interest is not stored (stale intraday; the page joins the last obs.option_eod value). A crossed quote (bid above ask) is kept as written: the dataset has no quality column.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| session_day | string (date) | no | Market-zone session date. |
| capture_id | string (uuid) | no | Identifier of the capture, a uuid. Deterministic per (session_day, slot, instrument_id), not random (option_eod's is random): a retry of a key after a partial write meets the primary key and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and cannot duplicate a row. |
| slot | string | no | Slot of the pull as four digits, for example 0945; the value refresh marks a row of the refresh button. |
| instrument_id | integer | no | Identifier of the option contract. |
| underlying_id | integer | no | Identifier of the underlying instrument. |
| plan_id | string (uuid) | no | Identifier of the plan (plan.option_open_item) the row was pulled from. |
| generation | integer | no | Generation of the instrument terms the capture used. |
| market_data_type | integer | no | Broker market data type of the tick: 1 live, 2 frozen, 3 delayed, 4 delayed frozen. |
